name: job-platform
description: Production-style Distributed Job Platform (Postgres source of truth + BullMQ + Kafka + Outbox)

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @job-platform/shared-types && npm run build -w @job-platform/shared-events && npm run build -w @job-platform/shared-kafka && npm run build -w @job-platform/shared-utils && npm run build -w @job-platform/database
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/dist packages/*/dist
